suffixes: all binary canonical words at every exact depth 0 through 8
hard_endpoints: exact equality of breadth-first hard continuation signatures
errors repaired and errors introduced by uniform replacement of all eight anchors
soft_endpoints: maximum and mean oriented positive-ray angle
soft_rule: descriptive only; no post-hoc numerical equivalence threshold

registered_gates.E0_source_and_numeric_integrity: all four frozen source/checkpoint digests match and all computed values are finite
registered_gates.A0_native_anchors_hard_correct_through_H: all native-anchor decisions are correct through H=8 in both seeds and all episodes
registered_gates.I0_known_seed0_defect_confined_to_empty_: in every fresh seed-0 episode, only state 2 at exact suffix depth 0 is wrong and decodes as 6; seed 1 and every positive suffix depth are correct
registered_gates.R0_uniform_R_reanchor_repairs_without_ha: all native errors are repaired and no hard errors are introduced by replacing every anchor with its R-incoming representative
registered_gates.F0_uniform_F_reanchor_repairs_without_ha: same criterion for the F-incoming representative
registered_gates.P0_incoming_routes_have_identical_hard_s: R-incoming and F-incoming representatives yield identical hard predictions for every declared suffix

scale_boundary: Native anchors retain their stored scale at H=0. Recurrent representatives are normalized. All positive-depth transitions normalize after applying a generator.
claim_boundary: This diagnoses two fixed learned checkpoints only.
Fresh coordinate episodes remain inside reconstructed D4 training support.
Hard equivalence does not imply exact soft or state equivalence.
Episode-conditioned incoming representatives are counterfactual initializations, not a deployable episode-independent embedding table.
Finite success through H=8 does not establish unbounded stability.
